scope: archives 31-40, 202-204, 212, 215, 220, 221, 440 and 517: the shop frames of five shopkeepers, the chip and bug-piece traders, the security cubes and locked doors, the mysterious light and the raft
provenance: Claude, 2026-09-20; wording decided against translations/story_source.jsonl and the terminology adopted in earlier batches, with 22 lines seeded from decisions those batches already made
tone: Five shopkeepers with five tics, kept apart in Korean by politeness level and ending: the department clerk is 합쇼체, the old dealer is 하게체, the 〜でマス one gets 〜습니당, the shady one drawls, and the standard clerk is plain 해요체.
notes: The 「 」 in every shop line wraps a chip name the engine inserts, so nothing after one takes a 을/를. Archive 40 is the trader frame, where the counts 3/10 are printed by the script and the Korean keeps them in the same place.
